hero.badge: Urubuga rukwiye rw'imicungire y'amashuri na TVET
hero.subtitle: Urubuga rumwe rw'inyandiko, imirimo, imicungire y'abarimu n'abanyeshuri, modire n'ibizamini, igenamiterere rya porogaramu ya TVET ishingiye ku bumenyi, n'imikorere yikora yo gukora raporo — rwakorewe abakuriye, abarimu, n'abanyeshuri.

featuresSection.title: Yakorewe Uburezi Bugezweho
featuresSection.subtitle: Buri kiranga cyateguwe hagamijwe abarimu — byoroshye, byihuse, kandi bishimisha koresha.

documentManagement.label: Imicungire y'Inyandiko
documentManagement.desc: Shyiraho, tunganya kandi urebe inyandiko, PDF n'ibikoresho by'ishuri hakurikijwe modire — hamwe no kubona mu buryo bwihuse no gukurikirana ababikuye.

assignmentWorkflow.label: Imikorere y'Imirimo
assignmentWorkflow.desc: Kora imirimo ifite igihe ntarengwa, wakire ibyatanzwe, usuzume byinshi icyarimwe, kandi usubize ibitekerezo — byose bikurikiranwa mu buryo bwikora.

teacherManagement.label: Imicungire y'Abarimu
teacherManagement.desc: Abakuriye binjiza abarimu, bakabashyira mu mashuri na modire, kandi bagacunga abarimu bafasha muri buri shuri.

studentManagement.label: Imicungire y'Abanyeshuri
studentManagement.desc: Andika abanyeshuri hakurikijwe urwego, umwuga n'umwaka w'ishuri, injiza amadosiye byinshi icyarimwe, kandi ukurikirane buri munyeshuri mu ilisiti imwe.

assessmentModules.label: Ibizamini na Modire
assessmentModules.desc: Tegura modire zifite amanota afite uburemere, hanyuma ukore ibizamini bya Formative (FA), Integrated (IA) na Comprehensive (CA) muri buri shuri.

onlineAssessments.label: Ibizamini kuri Interineti no Gusuzuma Byikora
onlineAssessments.desc: Kora ibibazo byo guhitamo, guhuza n'ibisubizo bifunguye, usangire ihuza rifite igihe n'umubare w'inshuro wemewe — ibibazo n'ibisubizo bivangwa kuri buri munyeshuri, isaha isuzumisha byikora igihe kirangiye, kandi ibisubizo bikasuzumwa ako kanya (hakiyongeraho isuzuma ry'intoki ku bibazo bifunguye).

reportManagement.label: Imicungire y'Amaraporo
reportManagement.desc: Kora raporo z'abanyeshuri, isesengura rya buri kizamini n'amaraporo yuzuye y'imikorere y'amashuri, biratondekanywa mu buryo bwikora.

tvetCurriculumSetup.label: Igenamiterere rya Porogaramu ya TVET
tvetCurriculumSetup.desc: Shyiraho Umwuga, Icyerekezo, Impamyabumenyi n'Urwego rwa RTQF kuri buri shuri — bijyanye na porogaramu za TVET zishingiye ku bumenyi.

markApprovalFlow.label: Imikorere yo Kwemeza Amanota
markApprovalFlow.desc: Amanota anyura mu byiciro Draft → Yoherejwe → Byemejwe hamwe n'isuzuma ry'ubuyobozi, kugira ngo amaraporo agaragaze ibyemejwe gusa.

smartAnnouncements.label: Amatangazo Yubwenge
smartAnnouncements.desc: Amatangazo y'ishuri cyangwa ay'ikigo yose hamwe no gukurikirana abayasomye, kugira ngo nta kintu cy'ingenzi kizigera kibura.

groupCollaboration.label: Gukorera Hamwe mu Matsinda
groupCollaboration.desc: Amatsinda yo kuganira ayoborwa n'abarimu afite abayobozi, hamwe n'uburyo bwo kuganira hagati y'abanyeshuri muri buri shuri.

enterpriseSecurity.label: Umutekano Ukomeye
enterpriseSecurity.desc: Kwinjira gushingiye ku gihe, uburenganzira hakurikijwe uruhare, ububiko bw'inyandiko bufunze, n'amateka yose y'ibikorwa arimo.

anyDevice.label: Ikoranabuhanga Ryose
anyDevice.desc: Urubuga rw'ubuyobozi, urw'umwarimu n'urw'umunyeshuri bikora neza — kuri mudasobwa, tablet, cyangwa telefoni.

realTimeNotifications.label: Amakuru Ahita Agera
realTimeNotifications.desc: Ikigo cy'amakuru cyihariye gifite umubare w'ibitarasomwa, gushyira ko byasomwe no gusiba byose, kugira ngo buri nota, ubutumwa n'itangazo bigere ku muntu ubikwiye ako kanya.

directMessaging.label: Ubutumwa Butaziguye n'Amajwi
directMessaging.desc: Ubutumwa bwihariye hagati y'umwarimu n'umunyeshuri no kuganira hagati y'abanyeshuri, hamwe n'amajwi n'ibindi bikoresho bishyirwa muri buri kiganiro.

studentsThrive.desc: Bonera ahantu hamwe ibintu byose — inyandiko, imirimo, amanota, n'amatangazo bihora bivugururwa.

sarahKim.text: EDUPLA yahinduye uko dutunganya ishuri ryacu. Gusuzuma, gukora raporo, no kuvugana — byose ku rubuga rumwe rwiza.

marcusReid.text: Nashoraga amasaha 3 buri mugoroba nkora impapuro. Ubu nashyiraho inyandiko mu masegonda 30 kandi abanyeshuri bakabihabwa ako kanya.

aishaJabari.text: Amaherezo porogaramu y'ishuri ishimishije gukoresha. Mbona imirimo yanjye yose, amanota, n'amatangazo ahantu hamwe.

davidLee.text: Imbonerahamwe y'isesengura y'ubuyobozi iduha ubushobozi bwo kubona ibirori ku ngingo ku bigo byose ako kanya. Gufata ibyemezo ntibyigeze bihuta gutya.

faqSection.title: Ibibazo Bikunze Kubazwa
faqSection.subtitle: Ibyo ukeneye kumenya byose mbere yo gutangira.

faqs.q: Ni mu gihe kingana iki dushobora gutangira?
faqs.a: Amashuri menshi ategurwa yose mu minota itarenze 30. Umuyobozi wo gutangira azajya akuyobora intambwe ku yindi mu gukora amashuri, kwongeraho abarimu, no kwandikisha abanyeshuri.

faqs.q: Ese EDUPLA ishyigikira imiterere ya porogaramu ya TVET?
faqs.a: Yego — buri shuri rishobora guhuzwa n'Umwuga, Icyerekezo, Impamyabumenyi n'Urwego rwa RTQF. Modire ziragwa iyo miterere, kandi ibizamini bya Formative, Integrated na Comprehensive bikurikiranwa mu buryo bwikora muri buri modire.
Igihe umwarimu yohereje amanota kandi umuyobozi ayemeje, raporo z'abanyeshuri, iz'ibizamini n'iz'imikorere y'amashuri zikorwa mu buryo bwikora — zihora zigaragaza amanota aheruka kwemezwa.
Yego rwose. Amakuru yose arafunzwe mu buryo bw'umutekano igihe cyose. Ntabwo dutunganya amakuru y'abakoresha kandi dukurikiza rwose imikorere myiza yo kurinda ibanga.

faqs.q: Ese abarimu bashobora gukora badafite interineti?
faqs.a: Gutegura amasomo no gukora inyandiko bikora nta interineti. Ibyatanzwe n'amanota bihuzwa mu buryo bwikora igihe interineti isubiye.
Yego — igicunga cy'Uturere gishyigikira ibigo bitagira umubare ntarengwa hamwe n'amaraporo ahurizwa hamwe n'uruhare rw'ubuyobozi kuri buri kigo.
